scope: bounded CHG-137 chart-system acceptance; not global UI certification
candidate_findings: No material wrong segment start/end geometry, inverted/collapsed stack, malformed mark, plot escape, or responsive overflow observed in the retained candidate captures.
Annotations/secondary axis, embedded main-editor chart, line, scatter, dense legend desktop/narrow/mobile, 200-percent reflow and keyboard capture remained visually bounded in the inspected PNGs.
base_comparison_findings: Retained base captures visibly show the R1 bar-family failures: overlapping/crowded legacy marks and legend/label crowding in the compared grouped/stacked/percent and horizontal families.
Candidate captures show separated logical bar segments and bounded comparison surfaces for those same families.
limitations: This is a bounded evidence review and is not a claim of global UI perfection.
